newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Athletics-Australian shatters pole vault mark.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Athletics-Australian shatters pole vault mark.

text.p: Australian Emma George shattered the women's indoor pole vault world record on Tuesday with a clearance of 4.40 metres, Athletics Australia said.
George, 22, who holds the outdoor record at 4.45 metres, raised the indoor world record by 12 centimetres in an event staged in a school gymnasium.
China's Sun Caiyun set the old mark of 4.28 metres in February this year.
Women's pole vault will be contested at the world indoor athletics championships in Paris next March, the first time the event has been included on the championship's programme.
